dialogue.speaker: Aigerim
dialogue.text: Malika! Where are you right now? I can see a lot of people!

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: I'm sitting in the WKU café! I'm having a coffee between lectures.

dialogue.speaker: Aigerim
dialogue.text: Who is sitting next to you?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Two boys from the Engineering faculty. They're arguing about something!

dialogue.speaker: Aigerim
dialogue.text: Ha! What are they arguing about?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: I think it's a maths problem. One of them is drawing something on paper.

dialogue.speaker: Aigerim
dialogue.text: Is anyone else working near you?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Yes! A girl near the window is typing on her laptop really fast. She's wearing headphones and isn't looking at anyone.

dialogue.speaker: Aigerim
dialogue.text: That sounds like me when I'm studying. What is the barista doing?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: He's making a cappuccino. It smells absolutely amazing. I think I want another one!

dialogue.speaker: Aigerim
dialogue.text: Stop it! Now — what are YOU doing, apart from watching everyone else?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: I'm reading my Psychology notes. And drinking coffee. And now I'm talking to you!

dialogue.speaker: Aigerim
dialogue.text: You're doing too many things at once! What am I doing right now, by the way?

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: I don't know — what ARE you doing?

dialogue.speaker: Aigerim
dialogue.text: I'm sitting in the library. I'm listening to you... and pretending to study.

dialogue.speaker: Malika
dialogue.text: Ha! We're both being terrible students today!
